title: group_join — input
description: Input schema for the SOX group_join operation. An invited agent accepts group membership. Transitions the calling agent's membership status from 'invited' to 'active'. The calling agent MUST already have status='invited' in the group membership table. Normative reference: spec/primitives/groups.md §5.3.

group_id.description: The full group channel name including the 'group/' prefix (e.g. 'group/eng-team').
